title: Semantic index migration
root_cause: Only four of 178 current semantic records have nonempty intent data because the index projects only contract.provides.
source_requirement: Build the active semantic index from canonical semantic profiles and retain source revisions.
implementation_steps: Adapt index builder to canonical profiles.
Backfill active routable skills from supported metadata.
negative_cases: Empty positive intent without explicit non-routable disposition.
focused_tests: Semantic index migration and deterministic regeneration tests.
affected_tests: Capability routing, skill registry, generated artifacts.
evidence_required: Before/after coverage denominator and deterministic builder receipt.
rollback: Restore prior generated index and builder together.
acceptance_criteria: Active routable skills no longer depend on the nearly empty provides projection.
Every index record binds its profile/source revision.
